Formalize can be seamlessly integrate into your existing stack using our native integrations or powerful API. ![](https://d3w4o7fl16gzp5.cloudfront.net/4775218b-2938-4b91-b797-4b98f310f698/assets/images/optimized/new-pricing-roomba-en.webp) ![](https://d3w4o7fl16gzp5.cloudfront.net/4775218b-2938-4b91-b797-4b98f310f698/assets/images/optimized/new-pricing-implementation-en.webp)![](https://d3w4o7fl16gzp5.cloudfront.net/4775218b-2938-4b91-b797-4b98f310f698/assets/images/optimized/new-pricing-roomba-en.webp) ## A compliance platform you can grow with Formalize provides a comprehensive solution for managing compliance; everything from risk and incident management to compliance data management in a single, integrated platform. With interlinked features to streamline and automate compliance workflows, Formalize offers complete customisation to your specific requirements, ensuring a seamless and efficient compliance management process. ##### Risk Management Streamline everything around your identified risks. Formalize tracks the version history for each risk. ##### Incident Management Incidents can be reported through the platform and automatically linked to your risks. ##### Policies Manage all your company policies and guidelines centralized in one place. You can share your policies with employees and other stakeholders. ##### Workflows Set-up automations for different processes, questionnaires, tasks, events or approval flows. ##### Supplier Audits Optimize your supplier audit workflows and simplify the processes. It is highly configurable, so you can improve and update your automations continuously. ##### Tasks Create and schedule single or recurring tasks for yourself or other users. The Annual-Wheel gives you a clear overview of all tasks within one year. ##### Governance Reporting Reports offer you cross-referencing information from multiple data elements in the system. Reports can be easily downloaded. ##### Custom Dashboards You can customize your own dashboards, creating your own visualizations all tailored to your needs. ##### Trust Center Document all the work you do in relation to compliance and best business practices. You can share privacy policies, code of conduct, link to whistleblowing channel, and more. ## Try Formalize today You can try Formalize for free with our 14 day free trial version.
